visual_review.clean_trial_0: Mouth settled by 400 ms and remains closed at later selected frames.
visual_review.residual_trial_1: Mouth visibly open at 200, 400, 1280 and 2000 ms; closed at 3000 ms. The 800 ms frame is missing.
visual_review.clean_repeat_trial_2: Open at 200 ms; closed at 800 ms and later selected frames. The 400 ms frame is missing.

causal_scope: Adding a two-second six-unit synthetic PCM tail caused sustained mouth opening through the exact runner queue/resampler and unchanged model. Does not establish actual provider/codec tail provenance.
notes: Raw PCM captures were ephemeral in the private runner container; retained artifacts contain their hashes and RMS envelopes.
All 24 full-length input hashes equal the corresponding paired audio hashes; these calls show no normalization divergence.
The initial collector failure was damaged serial JSON, not excessive generated frame count. The original <500 bound was restored; invalid rows were counted and rejected.
Runtime instrumentation and synthetic consumer pacing make this unsuitable for latency measurement.
No production model, image, configuration, account, key or deployment was changed.
